items.headline: Debris from Storm Shadow cruise missiles used in yesterday’s strike on one of the workshops at PJSC Proton-Electrotex in Oryol
items.excerpt: 🇺🇦🇷🇺⚡️ — Debris from Storm Shadow cruise missiles used in yesterday’s strike on one of the workshops at PJSC Proton-Electrotex in Oryol. This marks the third Russian military-industrial facility to be targeted with Storm Shadow missiles. The Kremniy El plant in Bryansk was struck in March, followed by the Sborka plant (JSC VZPP-S) in Voronezh in June.

items.headline: Assahifa (Moroccan Outlet) reports that Morocco has submitted an official request to the U.S. government to train Royal Moroccan Air Force (RMAF) pilots to operate F-35A fifth-generation multirole fighters
items.excerpt: 🇺🇸🇲🇦 Assahifa (Moroccan Outlet) reports that Morocco has submitted an official request to the U.S. government to train Royal Moroccan Air Force (RMAF) pilots to operate F-35A fifth-generation multirole fighters. According to the outlet’s sources, the move is linked to preparations for a potential acquisition of the aircraft.
